name: SUPER 시제 예문 : 영어 입 트기 작전 PART 5 (2/2)

keywords.en: I'm going to go see the new Steven Spielberg movie tomorrow.
keywords.ko: 내일 새 스티븐스필버그 영화를 보러 갈 거야

keywords.en: I first saw the trailer several months ago and I've been looking forward to it ever since.
keywords.ko: 몇개월전에 첫번째 트레일러를 봤는데, 그때 이후로 기대를 해왔다.

keywords.en: I wanted to catch an early morning movie,
but all the good seats were already taken.
I checked the evening schedule and it was worse.
There were barely any seats left.
So, I decided to go to a showing late in the afternoon.
keywords.ko: 그래서, 오후 늦게 하는 상영을 가기로 했다.

keywords.en: The movie ends at around half past 6, so it looks like I'll be heading home during rush hour.
keywords.ko: 6시반 쯤에 영화가 끝난다. 집에 돌아가게 러시아워에 집에 돌아가게
미래진행형 시제 : will be ~ing  (~ 모습을 상상하고 장면으로 묘사할 때)
내일 새 Steven Spielberg 영화를 보러 갈 예정이다.
몇 달 전에 처음 예고편을 봤는데, 그때부터 계속 기대하고 있었다.
아침 일찍 시작하는 영화를 보고 싶었지만 좋은 좌석은 이미 다 예약되어 있었다.
저녁 시간표를 확인해 봤는데 상황은 더 심했다.
그래서 늦은 오후 상영을 보기로 결정했다.

keywords.en: I’m going to go see the new Steven Spielberg movie tomorrow.
keywords.ko: 영화는 6시 30분쯤 끝나기 때문에 퇴근 시간에 집으로 가게 될 것 같다.

keywords.en: I first saw the trailer several months ago and I’ve been looking forward to it ever since.
I wanted to catch an early morning movie, but all the good seats were already taken.
I checked the evening schedule but it was worse
There were barely any seats left.
So, I decided to go to a showing late in the afternoon.
The movie ends at around half past 6, so It looks like I’ll be heading home during rush hour.

my_sentences.en: Do you want to catch a movie tonight?
my_sentences.ko: ⑤ catch a movie 영화를 보다 (캐주얼한 표현)

my_sentences.en: We caught a movie after dinner.
I caught a movie by myself.
There were barely any tickets left.
I have barely any money with me.
We had barely any time to prepare.
